thread:
alex_support: FYI customer reported abrupt disconnects during streaming when their app goes to background and then reconnects to Wi‑Fi. They get partial output and an ECONNRESET on client.
priya_eng: Can you paste the request id / logs? we need the server side trace to confirm whether we closed the socket or proxy timed out.
alex_support: Request id provided: req_01F7X9Z2. Customer logs:
```
[client] fetch stream error: TypeError: Failed to fetch
[client] network error: ECONNRESET
[client] last-chunk-received: "{\"choices\":[{\"text\":\"...partial text...\"}]}"
```
alex_support: They say it happens when switching from cellular -> Wi‑Fi while streaming on iOS 17. Happens ~30-45s after backgrounding the app.
ryan_oncall: Pulling server logs for req_01F7X9Z2 now — one sec.
deploy-bot: buildstatus: query logs for req_01F7X9Z2 -> found on edge-proxy-12, backend connection closed with RST.
ryan_oncall: Edge proxy shows `upstream write error: connection reset by peer` at 2026-03-15T14:12:03Z. Idle timeout at proxy is 60s. Customer reported 30-45s background, so could be client side TCP/OS behavior.
sara_mobile: On iOS, when app backgrounds, sockets can be suspended and NAT mapping can change when switching networks. The OS often SIGs or closes sockets rather than gracefully reusing. Apps need to re-establish SSE after network change.
priya_eng: Ok. Two questions: 1) are we billing for partial streams? 2) can we add better server-side handling to detect midstream client TCP reset and mark request as partial (so customer sees partial text but doesn't get charged for full)?
alex_support: Customer is worried about billing — they saw full tokens charged even though output was truncated. They attached billing snapshot showing a full generation billed.
ryan_oncall: Quick answer on billing: current hosted API bills tokens after generation completes or when stream termination signals end-of-response. If client resets the connection midstream, our backend finalizer may still count tokens if generation finished server-side. Need to check whether generation had finished before the reset.
priya_eng: For req_01F7X9Z2 logs show `generation complete` at 14:12:02Z then `tcp reset` at 14:12:03Z. Looks like server finished producing but client didn't receive final event. So billing records completion. Need to improve heuristics to detect if client disconnected before final bytes sent.
sara_mobile: Repro steps I used:
1) iPhone 14, iOS 17.2
2) Open app hitting streaming endpoint (SSE) with keepalive every 15s
3) Start generation, background app after streaming begins
4) Turn off cellular then join Wi‑Fi within 20–40s
5) Observe connection drops, client shows ECONNRESET and partial JSON
curl repro (simulates):
```
curl -N -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \
  -H \"Accept: text/event-stream\" \
  \"https://api.redwood.example/v1/streams?model=rwkv-13b\" \
```
(then simulate abrupt reset)
priya_eng: Thanks. Action items:
- ry an_oncall: collect more traces for similar request ids (15–30 occurrences this week) and aggregate proxy timeouts vs upstream resets.
- sara_mobile / docs: add note to mobile SDKs recommending immediate reconnect on network change and short keepalive.
- infra: propose proxy keepalive bump to 120s for streaming endpoints and experiment with `flush` semantics to ensure final bytes attempt before closing.
ryan_oncall: Will gather logs and make a list. Early observation: ~70% of these events show generation completed server-side; ~30% show generation still in progress and upstream aborted -> those should definitely be classed as partial outputs.
alex_support: Customer asked for workaround now — what's the recommended interim advice?
priya_eng: Tell them: implement client-side reconnect on network change, preserve context via conversation_id and request_id so they can resume or re-request missing portion. For billing, we can offer manual credit if they send request ids; engineering will triage high-frequency customers.
alex_support: I'll tell them and collect a few more request ids for credits. Also asked if we can expose a `stream_ack` event clients can send to ack final chunk to avoid ambiguous billing.
priya_eng: Interesting idea. We'll discuss design for an opt-in client ack that, if not received, flags charge review. Not a quick fix but feasible.
sara_mobile: I'll add a short blurb in mobile SDK readme about backgrounding + reconnect patterns.
ryan_oncall: Logging action: I'll tag the 20 recent req ids in a ticket with timestamps and initial classification (server-complete vs aborted-during-gen).
alex_support: Thanks team — will update customer and paste next set of ids here. :thumbsup:
